/ Straight answer

“And when a tool stops working?”

It happens. Shared tools need refreshing sometimes — anyone who tells you otherwise is selling you something. Here is exactly what happens when it does.

You message, a person answers

Not a ticket, not a bot, not an email you never hear back from. The same WhatsApp you used to buy — day or night.

We refresh it, usually fast

Most of the time it is a login that needs renewing and you are back in within the hour. That is the whole reason we are reachable 24/7.

You are never left stuck

If a tool cannot be brought back, we swap in the closest alternative from the stack — and if we still cannot make it right, talk to us and we will sort it out.

We would rather tell you this before you pay than have you find out after.
